objective: PMApp in-app updater P3 (technician update flow U1-U5) + P4 (publisher release screens A1-A2) in Flutter + Android native, matching the APPROVED HTML mockups pixel-faithfully (Design Fidelity Mode), wired to the live app-releases edge function. No release build, no version bump.
required_changes: GROUND TRUTH (read first, fully): docs/contracts/app-releases.md (live API; baseline 2.0.141 published: arm64 4154, arm32 3154), docs/updater/audit.md (sections 3 and 5: http package not supabase_flutter; x-app-session header pattern in lib/data/services/daily_task_service.dart:200-216 and location_service.dart:1298; anon key + base URL resolution in daily_task_service.dart:47-49,160-216; FileProvider authority ${applicationId}.direct_share_provider with provider_paths.xml restricted to share/; REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES absent; minSdk 24 target 36; packages present http, crypto, path_provider, package_info_plus, permission_handler). APPROVED design: docs/design/updater/*.html + README.md (data mapping, states, motion, Given/When/Then) + png/. Visual authority docs/design/DESIGN.md; reuse existing theme tokens (no raw hex in widgets).

NATIVE (MainActivity.kt, reuse the existing MethodChannel style there; add a channel or methods): getSupportedAbis -> Build.SUPPORTED_ABIS list; canInstallPackages -> packageManager.canRequestPackageInstalls() (API 26+, true below); openInstallPermissionSettings -> Settings.ACTION_MANAGE_UNKNOWN_APP_SOURCES with package: uri; installApk(path) -> FileProvider uri + ACTION_VIEW (or ACTION_INSTALL_PACKAGE) with application/vnd.android.package-archive + FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION + NEW_TASK; readApkInfo(path) -> packageManager.getPackageArchiveInfo -> {packageName, versionName, versionCode (longVersionCode on 28+)} for A2. Manifest: add <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES"/>. provider_paths.xml: add <cache-path name="apk_updates" path="updates/"/> (keep existing entries). Check Context7 (Android/Flutter docs) for the install intent on API 34-36; prefer native over a new plugin. Only add a pub dependency for the A2 file picker if no existing package can pick a file (check pubspec first, e.g. file_picker/image_picker already present); justify in the contract doc.

AppUpdateService (lib/data/services/app_update_service.dart): checkLatest() -> POST app-releases {action:'latest', abi:<first of SUPPORTED_ABIS in [arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64]>, current_code:int.parse(PackageInfo.buildNumber), current_version:PackageInfo.version}; returns null on no update or any network error (never block app start on failure; timeout 8s). download(release, url) -> Stream<DownloadProgress{received,total,bytesPerSec,eta}> using http.Client.send streaming to <cache>/updates/pmapp-<version_code>.apk.part with HTTP Range resume when .part exists (signed URL may expire after 900s: on 400/403 re-call checkLatest for a fresh url and resume); speed = moving average over last 3s. verify(file) -> size == size_bytes AND sha256 == release.sha256 (package:crypto, chunked, off the UI isolate if > 5MB e.g. compute/Isolate.run); on mismatch delete file -> U5 'File pembaruan rusak'. Rename .part to .apk only after verify. Storage full: catch FileSystemException ENOSPC -> U5 storage state. Delete stale updates/*.apk older than current version on start. Persist 'Nanti' dismissal per version_code in SharedPreferences for 12h (optional updates only; mandatory ignores it).

U1-U5 screens/sheets in lib/features/updater/ matching the approved HTML (layout, band/ticket element with v<current> -> v<new>, progress inside band, numeric percent + 'x,x / y,y MB' + speed + estimasi, steps list, permission explainer with toggle illustration, ready state 'Pasang sekarang', error variants with exact copy from the HTML). Indonesian number format (comma decimal). Mandatory (response.mandatory true) = full-screen route U4 with PopScope(canPop:false), no Nanti, user cannot reach the rest of the app until updated (still allow retry). Optional = bottom sheet U1 over the current screen. Motion per README (MOTION 1), respect MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf. Targets >= 48dp, text scale 1.3 without overflow at 360dp.

TRIGGERS: run checkLatest after splash finishes routing (lib/features/splash/screens/splash_screen.dart, after WhatsNew logic, do not delay splash) and on AppLifecycleState.resumed throttled to once per 30 min (add a lightweight observer in lib/main.dart or the updater feature; do not interfere with camera screens' own observers). Do not show while a camera capture screen is active if easy to detect; otherwise show on next resume. Works logged out (latest needs no session).

Install flow: after verify, if !canInstallPackages -> U3 permission explainer -> openInstallPermissionSettings -> on resume re-check -> ready state; then installApk. If user cancels the system installer, stay on ready state with 'Pasang sekarang' again.

P4 AppReleaseAdminService (lib/data/services/app_release_admin_service.dart): list / createUpload / uploadFile (PUT to signedUrl with Content-Type application/vnd.android.package-archive, streamed with progress) / publish / rollback / deleteDraft, all with x-app-session (same token source as other services). A1 'Rilis aplikasi' screen + A2 upload form + dialogs per approved HTML: entry ListTile in lib/features/camera/widgets/camera_drawer.dart inside the existing isSpv block (line ~155); screen calls list on open; on 403 show 'Akun ini belum punya akses rilis.' (allowlist is server-side, currently only usr_farhan). A2: pick .apk, readApkInfo; reject if packageName != com.bssparking.timemark.bssparking_timemark. ABI: readApkInfo scans the APK zip entries natively (java.util.zip.ZipFile) for 'lib/arm64-v8a/', 'lib/armeabi-v7a/', 'lib/x86_64/'; exactly one must be present (universal APK with several = reject 'Unggah APK per arsitektur, bukan universal.'); base_version_code = versionCode - offset(abi) and must be > 0. Compute sha256 + size on device (isolate), create_upload, upload with progress, publish after confirm dialog. Show server 400 field errors and 409 'Nomor versi harus lebih tinggi dari rilis sebelumnya.' Rollback dialog copy exactly as in a2.html.

TESTS test/updater/ (deterministic, no network): AppUpdateService abi pick order; checkLatest maps response + returns null on 500/timeout/invalid JSON (inject http.Client mock via constructor param); verify passes/fails on sha/size; resume sends Range header from .part length; Nanti suppression 12h ignored when mandatory; widget tests: U4 has no Nanti and PopScope blocks back; U2 shows percent + MB text; A2 shows 409 copy. Use existing test helpers/patterns in test/.

docs/contracts/updater-client.md: Dart service APIs, native channel methods + args, file locations, triggers, state machine (idle -> available -> downloading -> verifying -> needsPermission -> ready -> installing / error kinds), and how to test on device (publish a 2.0.142 later with tools/publish_release.mjs).
acceptance_criteria: flutter analyze clean for touched files; test/updater/ green; existing tests that touch splash/drawer still green (run them).
flutter build apk --debug --target-platform android-arm64 succeeds (compile check only, do not distribute).

Screens match approved HTML (screenshots of U1, U2, U4, A1 rendered via widget tests/goldens or a debug run saved to docs/screenshots/updater/, light, 390 width) and copy has no SHA/ABI/APK/versionCode on U1-U5.
Manifest has REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES; provider_paths has updates/ cache path; no service role or secrets in client.
